reason: Stdio MCP registers actual read-only GA4 Admin/Data API reports, Search Console tools, combined page analyses and local mapping tools.

tools.name: project_mappings
tools.description: List local domain/client mappings from PROJECTS_CONFIG.
tools.behavior: Reads PROJECTS_CONFIG JSON and returns its projects array, or an empty array for an unset/missing file. Returns JSON-stringified data in MCP text content.

tools.name: project_lookup
tools.description: Find a local project mapping by project name, client, or domain.
tools.behavior: Reads local mappings and returns the first project whose name, client or domain equals or contains the case-insensitive query, otherwise {found:false}. Returns JSON-stringified data in MCP text content.

tools.name: gsc_list_sites
tools.description: List Google Search Console sites visible to the current credentials.
tools.behavior: GETs Search Console sites visible to credentials. Returns JSON-stringified data in MCP text content.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.description: Run a raw Search Console Search Analytics query.

siteUrl.description: GSC property, e.g. sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/

tools.behavior: POSTs startDate/endDate, named dimensions, capped rowLimit, startRow (default 0), type (default web) to the encoded site searchAnalytics/query endpoint. Returns JSON-stringified data in MCP text content.
notes: Optional siteUrl/property requires MCP_DEFAULT_GSC_SITE/MCP_DEFAULT_GA4_PROPERTY respectively when omitted; missing effective value throws. Numeric GA4 property IDs gain properties/ prefix.
Handler caps rows via MAX_ROWS (default 25000); omitted raw report/query limit becomes 1000. No automatic row pagination.
Internal dimensionFilterGroups is not exposed in the registered schema.
YYYY-MM-DD is descriptive only; dates have no format or regex validation.

tools.name: find_high_impression_low_ctr_pages
tools.description: Find GSC pages with high impressions and low CTR.

siteUrl.description: GSC property, e.g. sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/

tools.behavior: Queries GSC page rows, keeps impressions >= minImpressions and ctr <= maxCtr, emits metrics and opportunityScore = round(impressions*(maxCtr-ctr+0.001)), sorted descending. Returns JSON-stringified data in MCP text content.
notes: Optional siteUrl/property requires MCP_DEFAULT_GSC_SITE/MCP_DEFAULT_GA4_PROPERTY respectively when omitted; missing effective value throws. Numeric GA4 property IDs gain properties/ prefix.
Handler caps rows via MAX_ROWS (default 25000); omitted raw report/query limit becomes 1000. No automatic row pagination.
YYYY-MM-DD is descriptive only; dates have no format or regex validation.

tools.name: compare_gsc_ga4_pages
tools.description: Join GSC page performance with GA4 landing-page engagement.

siteUrl.description: GSC property, e.g. sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/

tools.behavior: Concurrently requests GSC page rows and GA4 landingPagePlusQueryString with sessions, engagedSessions, engagementRate. Maps GA4 rows by normalized path, then emits each GSC page with joined metrics; missing GA4 engagement is null and other GA4 metrics are zero. Returns JSON-stringified data in MCP text content.
notes: Optional siteUrl/property requires MCP_DEFAULT_GSC_SITE/MCP_DEFAULT_GA4_PROPERTY respectively when omitted; missing effective value throws. Numeric GA4 property IDs gain properties/ prefix.
Handler caps rows via MAX_ROWS (default 25000); omitted raw report/query limit becomes 1000. No automatic row pagination.
YYYY-MM-DD is descriptive only; dates have no format or regex validation.

Join uses a Map with last row winning for duplicate normalized GA4 paths, without aggregating. Absolute URLs lose queries through URL.pathname, whereas relative landing paths keep query strings in the fallback; this can prevent matches. Results use only returned GSC rows.

tools.name: content_refresh_candidates
tools.description: Rank pages that may deserve a content refresh based on GSC opportunity and GA4 engagement.

siteUrl.description: GSC property, e.g. sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/

tools.behavior: Concurrently requests GSC page rows and GA4 landingPagePlusQueryString with sessions, engagedSessions, engagementRate. Maps GA4 rows by normalized path, then emits each GSC page with joined metrics; missing GA4 engagement is null and other GA4 metrics are zero. Computes refreshScore = impressions*max(0,0.08-ctr)+clicks*max(0,0.5-(engagementRate??0.5))*10, retains positive scores and sorts descending. Returns JSON-stringified data in MCP text content.

Source review only; no tools/list, upstream execution, or live requests.
All 20 tools are registered unconditionally in src/index.ts. Auth CLI is a separate npm auth command, not an MCP tool.
Zod raw shapes are expanded including shared dateRange/gscSite/ga4Property objects. Zod objects strip unknown keys; additionalProperties false reflects exposed schema.
API requests require OAuth token/client files or service-account key. Authentication requests read-only webmasters and analytics scopes. No concrete unusable entrypoint found by source inspection.
